semantic.justification: Consumed Calendar::getActualMaximum(UCAL_DATE) branch from ICU78.3 calendar.cpp, including its original clone and prepareGetActual writes. Other limit-helper branches are not exposed by this fragment. Unconsumed APIs, native ABI/mutex/allocator and undefined-input behavior, complete UNO/display formatting, formatter/column auto-input and final CSV integration remain outside the evidence for this module. No alternate calendar selection or unsupported-known-type error is introduced.
